evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema, likely related to adjacent meniscal pathology.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear of the medial meniscus body and posterior horn with dominant complete radial component at the posterior horn-root junction.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Degeneration without discrete tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Articular cartilage irregularity with areas of full-thickness fissuring at the weightbearing aspect of the joint.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the posterior lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.PF OA: Diffuse low-grade cartilage loss at the patella with areas of full-thickness fissuring at the lateral and medial facets. Focal high-grade cartilage loss of the central trochlea.
evidence.Effusion: Moderate joint effusion, incompletely imaged, with synovial proliferation.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema at the medial tibial plateau, likely reactive.
evidence.Fracture: concerning for early subchondral insufficiency fracture.
